legacy_rows.Eligibility / restrictions: All current full-degree undergraduate and postgraduate students, any subject/year; visa and prior-internship exclusions
legacy_rows.Delivery / credit / practical activity: Paid part-time internships in university departments and external employers. 2026/27 includes seven-week employer projects and 24-week university roles, normally ten hours weekly. Competitive recruitment; registration required throughout.
legacy_rows.Basis for reach classification: Published eligibility explicitly covers all subjects and years, at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
legacy_rows.Latest dated / current evidence: 2026/27 opportunities confirmed; Term 1 applications closed 7 October 2026
